SourceFile
  RootPackage
    @CLayout(aligned = 8, packed = 1)
  struct Packed
    field flag: Boolean
    field value: Int
    @Extern(lib = "m23_cabi", name = "m23_packed")
  fun transform(value: Packed): Packed
  fun main()
    @Unsafe block
      val result
        Call transform
          Call Packed
            BoolLiteral true
            IntLiteral 41
      Call println
        FieldAccess flag
          Var result
      Call println
        FieldAccess value
          Var result
